The owner reported the expected branch, base, PR, and head values after the corrected checkout workflow and authorized progression to production TTS integration. The verified head was 23a36f3c5842c7bbc7d983dad073011ba9e85118; the current head must always be read from the fetched remote ref.

A full LAN-enabled Windows package and clean-folder smoke test remain.

known_limits.details: Held emote state is in memory. A full LAN process restart cannot restore a held emote that existed before the process stopped.
Hidden and inactive media behavior was observed working, but no quantitative CPU or GPU benchmark has been recorded.
GitHub currently reports no commit status contexts for PR #8. This is not a passing CI suite; local and live validation remain required.
The first npm install reported one low and one high vulnerability. The dependency paths have not yet been reviewed, and npm audit fix must not be run automatically during checkout verification.
Phase 2 remains on a draft pull request and is not merged into agent/lan-mode or main.
